messages:
erin: morning async standup — API gateway: finished rate-limit middleware refactor. Blocker: one integration test flaky for auth retries. Today: will debug tests + open PR for routing policy TTL change.

mike: thanks erin. I reviewed the refactor locally, looks good. saw one nit in header parsing. I'll drop a quick comment on the PR. :thumbsup:

dalia: what env did the flaky test happen in? staging or CI? we saw similar in canary last week.

erin: CI (ubuntu-22). reproduces with long auth latency + 429 from downstream. suspect our retry backoff not honoring X-Retry-After.

samir: I can take a look at the test tonight. ping me @erin for repro steps.

anya: FYI I pushed a small change to routing policies to prefer region-local pools for low-latency routes — hoping it helps. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/412

deploy-bot: deploy started for platform/main -> staging at 1773456900 :rocket:

mike: re rate limits: are we applying per-customer-window or per-api-key? we had a discussion last month.

erin: currently per-api-key with fallback to org-level. plan: add explicit per-customer config by EOD if time.

dalia: blocker for me: need a migration plan for existing rate-limit rows in redis. still sketching.

samir: quick note — for auth retries, avoid doubling token refreshes. patch idea:

```
if (auth.inflightRefresh) {
  await auth.inflightRefresh;
} else {
  auth.inflightRefresh = refreshToken();
  try { await auth.inflightRefresh } finally { auth.inflightRefresh = null }
}
```

mike: that pattern looks solid.

erin: thanks samir — can you open a mini-PR with that pattern? will help the flaky test.

samir: on it, targetting the same repo path: gateway/auth/refresh.ts

anya: also bumped rate-limit default to 200 RPS for dedicated routes in the config file.

erin: OK — plan for today: 1) pair with samir on test repro, 2) land retry fix, 3) follow up on routing TTL PR. If anyone needs me, slack me @erin. otherwise LGTM on other patches. :white_check_mark:

mike: I'll leave one last review on erin's refactor after samir's PR lands.

dalia: blocking doc update for ops runbook — will send a draft later today.

deploy-bot: deploy succeeded for platform/main -> staging at 1773456995 :white_check_mark:

erin: thanks team, keeping an eye on staging metrics.
